# People Data Labs

PeopleDataLabs provides B2B data enrichment and identity resolution, empowering organizations to build enriched user profiles and validate customer information

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/peopledatalabs/.

## Actions

- **Autocomplete field suggestions** (read-only): Provides autocompletion suggestions for a specific field (e.g., company, skill, title) based on partial text input.
- **Clean company data** (read-only): Cleans and standardizes company information based on a name, website, or profile url.
- **Clean location data** (read-only): Cleans and standardizes a raw, unformatted location string into a structured representation, provided the input is a recognizable…
- **Generate Search Query**: Converts natural language queries into structured pdl elasticsearch queries for people or company searches.
- **Get column details** (read-only): Retrieves predefined enum values for a column name from enum mappings.json.
- **Get schema** (read-only): Retrieves the schema, including field names, descriptions, and data types, for 'person' or 'company' entity types.
- **Person Search with Elasticsearch** (read-only): Performs a search for person profiles within people data labs using a custom elasticsearch domain specific language (dsl) query.
- **Clean school data** (read-only): Cleans and standardizes school information.
- **Enrich Company Data** (read-only): Enriches company data from people data labs with details like firmographics and employee counts, requiring at least one company identifier.
- **Enrich IP Data** (read-only): Enriches an ip address with company, location, metadata, and person data from people data labs.
- **Enrich job title data** (read-only): Enhances a job title by providing additional contextual information and details.
- **Enrich person data** (read-only): Enriches person data using various identifiers.
- **Enrich skill data** (read-only): Retrieves detailed, standardized information for a given skill by querying the people data labs skill enrichment api.
- **Identify person data** (read-only): Retrieves detailed profile information for an individual from people data labs (pdl), requiring at least one identifier such as email,…
- **People Search with Elasticsearch** (read-only): Searches for person profiles in the people data labs (pdl) database using an elasticsearch domain specific language (dsl) query.
